name: Albert Corporation
note: The company behind the Albert personal financial assistant app; jersey patch partner of los-angeles-lakers (2026-27). General Atlantic lists Albert among its investments (2021) but is one investor, not a control owner; no control owner is disclosed. Albert's January 2021 Series C ($100m) was led by General Atlantic with CapitalG (Alphabet's growth fund), Portag3 and QED participating, bringing total funding to $173m (see claim albert-series-c-investors).
